findings.detail: Plain Qwen3-VL raw output returns final hidden rows unchanged (width=hidden); trained ColQwen/Nemotron readout projection/normalization preserved. Real CPU test raw_output_rows(None,...).

compare_quality requires every expected fixture, pool0/pool1/pool2 and raw (with --allow-raw), rejects duplicate native/oxide records and validates width/sequences/cumulative/value counts before metrics. 5 adversarial CPU tests pass.
controller_v3 uses remote consumer paths (host-consumer/native-consumer/quality-consumer) instead of host-absolute /tmp/opencode paths.
quality consumer SHA is read from host-consumer/quality-binary.sha256 when present; absent means explicit pending_build, never a fake sha.
Rust CPU writer/readout test added for plain raw hidden rows; controller pins include controller_v3/tests/compare parser tests.
